title: Punjab Communications Ltd. v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Punjab Communications Ltd. v. Union of India, (1999) 4 SCC 727
content.facts: A policy change was challenged on the basis of an expectation arising from prior governmental practice.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the distinction between procedural and substantive legitimate expectation?
content.ratioDecidendi: The doctrine may protect procedural expectations and, in appropriate cases, substantive expectations, but policy may change for overriding public interest and lawful reasons.
content.holding: The Court explained the procedural/substantive distinction and limits.
content.relevance: Use for modern classification and public-interest limitations.
